scheme.title: Processing Status
scheme.description: How far the data has been processed, as declared by whoever registers it. MOSAIC does not verify it; a record without it is shown as not stated (nothing is inferred).

concepts.label: Raw
concepts.description: As supplied by the contributor; not processed.

concepts.label: Processed
concepts.description: Cleaned, reformatted or harmonised by the contributor.

concepts.label: Validated
concepts.description: The contributor reports that it has been quality-checked.
